notes:
Map Data filters by server again. Picking a server at the top stopped filtering that page, which had been the case since 1.41.3. Nothing was lost or changed in your saved map data — only what the page chose to show you.

Some accounts went missing when you filtered by a server. A server name could be stored with different capitals and the two were treated as different servers, quietly leaving accounts out — including from a per-server launch. Corrected automatically on first start.

Server tabs on the Bots page: All, then one per server with a count, so you can work one server at a time. Your labels and separators follow their own accounts.

The More menu no longer runs past its edge.
